response.sql: WITH team_rates AS (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS avg_win_rate, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM manager_half GROUP BY team_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) AS mean_win_rate FROM team_rates) SELECT t.team_id, t.avg_win_rate, t.record_count, t.avg_win_rate - o.mean_win_rate AS difference FROM team_rates AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_win_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;
